messages:
Maria: Heads-up — acme-corp just reported ~40 users lost roles after an SSO attribute rename on their IdP. They said the group claim changed from `groups` -> `memberOf` and our SCIM connector didn’t map anything.
Sachin: Yikes. Which mapping type did they have configured (groupName->role vs externalId)?
Maria: groupName->role via Okta Push connector. IdP admin confirmed they renamed the outgoing claim namespace yesterday.
Provisioning-bot: [1787654321.000100] connector=okta-conn-42 status=200 incoming_attrs=["memberOf"] scim_mapped_groups=[] members_processed=0
Alex: Can you paste the SCIM/provisioning logs for the webhook? Also does the connector config include a custom claim path?
Maria: Logs snippet:
```
2026-02-12T15:02:03Z INFO incoming SAML attr 'memberOf' received
2026-02-12T15:02:03Z WARN scim: expected claim 'groups' not found in payload
2026-02-12T15:02:03Z INFO payload keys: ["id","email","memberOf"]
2026-02-12T15:02:04Z ERROR mapping: unable to resolve role for group 'Engineering' (no match in group->role map)
```
Jamie: Looks like our default mapper only inspects `groups`. We don't currently fallback to group-like claims or provide an alias list per-connector.
Sachin: Customer is blocked from internal dashboards; they want a hotfix ASAP.
Alex: Short-term mitigation: requeue the webhook payloads and run a mapping backfill that treats `memberOf` as `groups` (attribute_alias). I can run the backfill if we have approval.
Jen: Longer term we should add connector-level claim aliasing (configurable array) + tests. I'll open a spec.
Maria: Customer approved the backfill. They also asked for a one-time audit of role assignments and a manual reassign for any service accounts. Requested steps: 1) requeue last 72h of Okta push events for connector okta-conn-42 2) run mapping backfill with alias `memberOf` -> `groups` 3) surface audit for users that still fail mapping (missing externalId / ambiguous email)
Provisioning-bot: job queued job_id=jb_8891 action=backfill scope=72h attr_alias={"memberOf":"groups"}
Alex: Running backfill now. Will patch a small script to translate claim names in payloads, re-run the mapping job, then post results. :thumbsup:
Alex: Backfill finished (job_id=jb_8891) — remapped 37 users, 1 user failed due to missing externalId (service account). Audit log: https://internal.redwood/prov/jobs/jb_8891
Sachin: Confirmed with acme-corp on call — 36 users regained expected roles, 1 pending (svc acct). They’re grateful, asked for permanent fix.
Jamie: Filed INF-4323 to add claim aliasing and a connector UI field so admins can map custom claim names. Added acceptance criteria and unit tests.
Maria: I'll follow up with the customer to close the loop and schedule a docs update (connector guide: claim names + troubleshooting). Thanks everyone. :eyes:
